name: Basicplan Pattern
description: The basic plans. This content ontology design patterns represents plans descriptions and their executions. It is defined by combining and expanding other CPs: basic plans description, basic plans execution, and object role. Expansion involves the partial clone of ontology elements from DOLCE Ultra Lite and Plans Lite ontologies.
competency_questions: Which activity actually carried out a given task, and which task does a particular activity carry out?; Who holds or shares a given plan, and which plans does a particular person or team have in mind?; Which goals have actually been reached, and which of them were reached incidentally rather than by carrying out a plan?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
